stem: Avascular necrosis of the femoral head in children under $10$ years old is predominantly a mechanical condition. What key clinical feature of inflammatory arthritis is typically missing in these patients?
explanation: Because avascular necrosis is mechanical, patients typically do not experience the prolonged stiffness in the morning that characterizes inflammatory arthritis.
rationale: Contrast the signs of mechanical joint wear with the hallmark signs of systemic inflammation.

optionExplanations.A: These patients actually do have reduced range of motion on examination, which is a key sign to look for.
optionExplanations.B: Limping is a common presentation for both mechanical and inflammatory hip issues.
optionExplanations.C: Because avascular necrosis is mechanical, patients typically do not experience the prolonged stiffness in the morning that characterizes inflammatory arthritis.
optionExplanations.D: Pain is the primary symptom that brings these children to clinical attention.
